metadata.description: Internal WESEO Cursor plugins for WordPress, WST, server-side WordPress operations, and local frontend QA.

plugins.name: wst-builder
plugins.description: WESEO WST Builder workflows for WordPress, ACF, and WST Section and Custom Post Type foundation work.

plugins.name: frontend-design-qa
plugins.description: WESEO local frontend implementation guidance for CSS, Figma-to-code translation, and Playwright-oriented Section and CPT QA.

plugins.name: wordpress-server-ops
plugins.description: WESEO server-phase guidance for safe Cursor Remote-SSH work in WordPress and WST projects.

plugins.name: smartflow
plugins.description: The complete WESEO WordPress/WST workflow in one plugin: server-side WST Section and CPT foundations, local frontend CSS, and Playwright QA. Successor to the wst-builder, frontend-design-qa, and wordpress-server-ops plugins; uninstall all legacy packages before installing.

plugins.name: smartflow-beta
plugins.description: Beta channel of smartflow. Pre-release build for WESEO frontend beta testers; opt in only to test upcoming changes, not for production work. Uninstall all legacy packages before installing.
